# LNT002 `unused-suppression`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

An inline suppression silences nothing.

## Why

The code it was written for has changed or moved: the stale comment now hides nothing, but would
silently hide a future finding on that line. Remove it.

## Reported

```fortran
integer :: n  ! fobis: ignore[COR020] n is not initialised any more
```

## Preferred

```fortran
integer :: n
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[LNT002] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = LNT002` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).
